Oral health affects **all** your health, both physical and mental. 
* Dental coverage to fit a range of needs
* Plan options that bundle vision and hearing, too
* Coverage costs pennies a day
* Shop online anytime, 24/7/365

* Available for shopping during Open Enrollment (Nov 1 - Dec 15, in most states)

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.

## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,

reliable and exceptional experience

The Association of Asthma Educators honored Leandra Tonweber, PA‑C, AE‑C, Director of Community
Support Programs, as “Asthma Advocate of the Month” for her leadership in community‑based asthma
education. Leandra leads the award‑winning [**Virtual Asthma Coaching program**][289], which
provides trusted asthma education and support to those experiencing higher asthma burden. This
recognition underscores Allergy & Asthma Network’s commitment to health equity and improved asthma
outcomes.

What Banner Offers

From treating minor injuries to delivering a baby, Banner Health is here to support you and your
family with safe, high-quality care. With options like telehealth services and virtual tools for
in-person visits, we make it easy to access the care you need. [Learn more about all the services we
provide][29].

### Urgent Care


Convenient care for non-emergency needs. Schedule online or walk in and start feeling better. [Learn
more.][30]

### Imaging


Advanced technology and expert teams deliver precise diagnostics and exceptional care. [Learn
more.][31]

### Surgery Centers


A lower-cost, convenient alternative to inpatient procedures with a smooth, at-home recovery. [Learn
more. ][32]

### Maternity


Guiding you through pregnancy with comfort, knowledge and expert care. [Learn more.][33]

### Hospice


Compassionate end-of-life care and support for you and your loved ones. [Learn more.][34]

### Home Care


Safe, comfortable recovery at home after illness or injury. [Learn more.][35]

### Telehealth


Quality care, wherever you are. Connect with providers from home. [Learn more.][36]

### Emergency


24/7 expert care, close to home. Stay connected during your visit with our Chatbot. [Learn
more.][37]

Up in the middle of the night with a sick child? Wondering if that cold or lingering cough is
something more serious? Being sick or trying to care for a sick loved one can be stressful but
finding the right care or treatment shouldn’t be. Our symptom checker can help you find the right
care.

What Banner Offers

From treating minor injuries to delivering a baby, Banner Health is here to support you and your
family with safe, high-quality care. With options like telehealth services and virtual tools for
in-person visits, we make it easy to access the care you need. [Learn more about all the services we
provide][29].

### Urgent Care


Convenient care for non-emergency needs. Schedule online or walk in and start feeling better. [Learn
more.][30]

### Imaging


Advanced technology and expert teams deliver precise diagnostics and exceptional care. [Learn
more.][31]

### Surgery Centers


A lower-cost, convenient alternative to inpatient procedures with a smooth, at-home recovery. [Learn
more. ][32]

### Maternity


Guiding you through pregnancy with comfort, knowledge and expert care. [Learn more.][33]

### Hospice


Compassionate end-of-life care and support for you and your loved ones. [Learn more.][34]

### Home Care


Safe, comfortable recovery at home after illness or injury. [Learn more.][35]

### Telehealth


Quality care, wherever you are. Connect with providers from home. [Learn more.][36]

### Emergency


24/7 expert care, close to home. Stay connected during your visit with our Chatbot. [Learn
more.][37]

Up in the middle of the night with a sick child? Wondering if that cold or lingering cough is
something more serious? Being sick or trying to care for a sick loved one can be stressful but
finding the right care or treatment shouldn’t be. Our symptom checker can help you find the right
care.

[Start Now][38]

excel. Whether designing health and wellness programs to prepare athletes for the demands of a
season or helping them recover from injuries, the Banner Orthopedics & Sports Medicine team delivers
unmatched care and support.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Throughout the Biohealth Ecosystem

Research & Academic
Medical Device
Digital Health
Biotechnology

BioForward members in this sector focus on cutting-edge research and education in biohealth. They
work within universities and research institutions, driving innovations and advancements in the
field through extensive studies and academic contributions.

This sector includes companies that design and manufacture medical devices. These BioForward members
are at the forefront of developing new technologies and products that improve patient care,
diagnostics, and treatment outcomes.

BioForward members in the digital health sector integrate technology with healthcare. They develop
software, apps, and digital solutions that enhance healthcare delivery, patient monitoring, and data
management, fostering a more connected and efficient healthcare system.

Biotechnology sector members focus on using biological processes and organisms to develop products
and technologies. Their work spans various industries, including pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and
environmental science, aiming to solve complex biological challenges and improve quality of life.

### Patient Information

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

Expand

The following information applies to both EPIPEN and its Authorized Generic

EPIPEN^{®} (epinephrine injection, USP) 0.3 mg and EPIPEN JR^{®} (epinephrine injection, USP) 0.15
mg Auto-Injectors are used to treat allergic emergencies (anaphylaxis). Anaphylaxis can be life
threatening and happen within minutes. If untreated, anaphylaxis can cause death. This allergic
emergency can be caused by stinging and biting insects, allergy injections, foods, medicines,
exercise, or unknown causes.

**Always carry 2 EPIPEN or 2 EPIPEN JR Auto-Injectors** with you because sometimes a single dose of
epinephrine may not be enough to treat a serious allergic reaction before seeking medical care.

**When you have an allergic emergency (anaphylaxis), use EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors right
away**. Get emergency medical help right away even if you have used the EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR
auto-injector. You can use a second EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector if symptoms continue or if the
first auto-injector is activated. If you need more than 2 doses for an allergic emergency, they must
be given by a healthcare provider.

**Before you use EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors, tell your healthcare provider about all your
medical conditions.** Your healthcare provider may give you more instructions about when and how to
use EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR if you have heart problems or high blood pressure, diabetes, thyroid
problems, asthma, a history of depression, Parkinson’s disease, are pregnant or plan to become
pregnant, are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed.

Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you take, including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and herbal supplements. Tell your healthcare provider about all
of your known allergies. If you have certain medical conditions, or take certain medicines, your
condition may get worse, or you may have longer lasting side effects when you use your EPIPEN or
EPIPEN JR auto-injector.

**Especially tell your healthcare provider if you take certain asthma medicines.** EPIPEN and EPIPEN
JR and other medicines may affect the way other medicines work. Other medicines may affect how
EPIPEN and EPIPEN JR auto-injector works.

EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector should be injected into the middle of your outer thigh (upper
leg), through clothing if necessary. **Do not** inject into your veins, buttocks, fingers, toes,
hands or feet. **It is very important that you hold the EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector down
firmly on the middle of the outer thigh (upper leg) for at least 3 full seconds. If you do not hold
it in place long enough, the EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injector might not have time to deliver the
correct dose of medicine. ** If you accidentally inject EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors into any
place other than the middle of your outer thigh, go to the nearest emergency room right away. If you
inject a young child, hold their leg firmly in place before and during the 3 second injection to
prevent injuries.

Rarely, patients who have used EPIPEN or EPIPEN JR auto-injectors may get infections at the
injection site within a few days. Some of these infections can be serious. Call your healthcare
professional right away if you have any of the following at an injection site: redness that does not
go away, swelling, tenderness, or the area feels warm to the touch.

community to support the more than 33 million people who have food allergy, which can cause
life-threatening reactions.

# Gateway FEAST: Food Allergy, Eczema, and Asthma Support Team

[Support group for allergies]

## Welcome to Gateway FEAST

Gateway FEAST is a support group and educational resource for people who manage food allergies,
eczema, and asthma, serving the St. Louis area community in Missouri and Illinois. We offer support
and education to members through our **[Facebook group][20]** and member events, promote community
awareness about allergic conditions through our outreach programs, and work in concert with other
St. Louis area organizations to host community events for children with life-threatening food
allergies and their families.

Gateway FEAST is an all-volunteer organization, founded and run by families that live with allergic
conditions, and recommended by local allergists and by national allergy and asthma organizations
including [Food Allergy Research and Education][21] (FARE) and the [Allergy and Asthma Foundation of
America][22] (AAFA).

What do the letters in FEAST stand for?

**F**ood Allergy
**E**czema
**A**sthma, Seasonal **A**llergy, and Environmental **A**llergy
**S**upport
**T**eam

[Events for kids with food allergies]

## Events for children with food allergies and their families

Gateway FEAST works with multiple St. Louis area organizations to offer allergy-friendly events that
make children with food allergies and their families feel welcome and included.

Learn more about Gateway FEAST events on our [Events page][23].

including [Food Allergy Research and Education][21] (FARE) and the [Allergy and Asthma Foundation of
America][22] (AAFA).

What do the letters in FEAST stand for?

**F**ood Allergy
**E**czema
**A**sthma, Seasonal **A**llergy, and Environmental **A**llergy
**S**upport
**T**eam

[Events for kids with food allergies]

## Events for children with food allergies and their families

Gateway FEAST works with multiple St. Louis area organizations to offer allergy-friendly events that
make children with food allergies and their families feel welcome and included.

Learn more about Gateway FEAST events on our [Events page][23].

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

## [ Glooko Expands EHR Integration Through Xealth: Diabetes Data, Embedded in the EHR ][59]

July 15, 2026

For health systems that use Xealth to manage digital health applications, diabetes data integration
no longer needs to be a tradeoff between workflow simplicity and clinical depth. By deploying
Glooko’s diabetes management EHR integration capabilities through the Xealth platform, healthcare
providers can bring rich diabetes data directly into EHR workflows while preserving the architecture
and digital care strategy that care teams already trust. Many health systems rely on Xealth to
prescribe, deliver and monitor digital health tools directly from the EHR, making it a central part
of many digital care strategies. Xealth’s Digital Care SMART on FHIR capabilities allow clinicians
to launch digital solutions from existing charting workflows, surface partner dashboards within the
EHR, and return discrete patient data into the chart for easier review and follow-up care. By
integrating Glooko’s diabetes management platform through Xealth, clinicians can remain in their
familiar workflow while accessing Glooko diabetes reports, connected device data and discrete values
that support efficient documentation, informed decision-making and more streamlined diabetes visits.
Glooko Expanded EHR Capabilities Through the Xealth Platform Glooko EHR integrations through Xealth
can now support the complete suite of core capabilities health systems look for in a diabetes data
workflow: Glooko Patient Portal for Professionals: One-click access to the patient’s Glooko account
from within the EHR window, reducing the need to switch platforms or leave the EHR.* PDF Report
Integration: Attaches Glooko diabetes data to the patient’s EHR record. Flowsheet Statistics:
Delivers discrete data including pump settings into the flowsheet of the EHR for easy documentation
and analysis. Create Patient Account: Creates a patient account using data from the EHR. Single
Sign-On: Secure, centralized access for professional admin users. Functional Parity Through Xealth A
major advantage for health systems using Xealth is functional parity with Glooko’s broader EHR
integration package. For organizations that rely on Xealth as their digital health orchestration
layer, this means there is no need to compromise on integration depth. These health systems can
simply extend existing Xealth environments with Glooko, gaining both a full visual report for
clinical review and structured data that supports documentation, trending over time, and more robust
clinical analysis. Better Workflow, Better Clinical Context This integrated approach streamlines
day-to-day clinical workflows by reducing manual steps and making diabetes data easier to access at
the point of care. Instead of printing, scanning and uploading diabetes reports for every visit,
clinicians can receive Glooko PDF summaries automatically in the EHR, helping to eliminate a
time-consuming process and free up time during visits. Unlocking More Efficient, Data-Driven
Diabetes Care With Xealth and Glooko If your health system uses Xealth to manage digital health
applications, Glooko can extend that investment with EHR-integrated diabetes data workflows that
match the depth of a traditional integration approach. The result is a more efficient experience for
care teams, richer clinical context inside the EHR, and a stronger path to scalable, data-driven
diabetes care. To learn more, reach out to your dedicated Glooko Customer Success Manager or
[[email protected]][60].   *One-click access to Glooko patient accounts from within the EHR is
currently available for Epic only.

[ Learn More ][61]
[ [The ROI of EHR-Integrated Diabetes Data] ][62]
1 MIN READ

## [ The ROI of EHR-Integrated Diabetes Data ][63]

July 6, 2026

Download the Case Study Now The Challenge: Manual Bottlenecks & Disconnected Data Managing a high
volume of patients using hundreds of different diabetes devices created significant operational
challenges for Michigan Medicine, including: 25-Minute Rooming Process: Hunting for device cords and
logging into disparate platforms. Heavy Administrative Burden: Manually typing data from printed
device reports into patient charts. High Risk & Costs: Increased risk of human error with manual
data entry and massive paper waste (up to 100 pages per patient). The Solution: Seamless Epic®
Integration via Glooko Michigan Medicine deployed Glooko’s device-agnostic platform directly inside
their Epic® system, creating a unified, automated digital workflow with: One-Click Access: Direct
access from the patient chart via Single Sign-On (SSO). Automated Data Flow: Instant delivery of PDF
reports and flowsheet statistics upon device upload. Universal Compatibility: One secure platform
supporting over 200 diabetes device brands. Inside the Case Study: Proven Results: Measurable ROI of
improved efficiency, including $30K in direct cost savings annually and 91 full work days of
clinical time reclaimed. Blueprint: How they mapped low-effort, high-impact EHR enhancements.
Sustainability: Using “Centers of Truth” clinic hubs to onboard staff and mitigate turnover. Scale:
Moving from reactive data chasing to proactive, data-driven diabetes care. Get the Case Study Now
Discover how to eliminate administrative burden and reclaim clinical hours.

[ Learn More ][64]
[ [Glooko Platform Adds Tandem Cloud Connectivity] ][65]
3 MIN READ

## [ Glooko Platform Adds Tandem Cloud Connectivity ][66]

June 29, 2026

The Glooko diabetes management platform is now cloud-connected with Tandem insulin pumps, giving
care teams automatic, continuous access to pump data without manual uploads, cables, or patient
intervention. Once a patient links their Tandem Source account, data will synchronize automatically
and continuously to the Glooko platform, ready for in-office visits and remote monitoring. This
integration reflects our ongoing commitment to ensure that wherever a patient’s data lives —
whichever device they wear, whichever platform stores it — that data flows seamlessly into the
platform their care team relies on. Expanding cloud connectivity is central to our mission of
bridging the gap between people living with diabetes and their healthcare providers. Why
Cloud-to-Cloud Integration Matters For people living with diabetes who use an insulin pump, data is
only useful if their care team can access it efficiently. Until now, that often meant asking
patients to remember to upload their device data before an appointment, or handling that step in the
clinic—an extra task that slows down the visit and, in some cases, means arriving without the data
at all. A direct cloud connection eliminates that friction. The Tandem mobile apps upload pump data
to the Tandem Source platform approximately once per hour. With this new integration, that
data—including basal and bolus deliveries, glucose trends, pump status, alerts and alarms—flows
automatically into the Glooko platform without cables or manual steps. What Automatic Sync Delivers
The core value of this integration is time: time recovered in the exam room, time saved across a
busy clinic schedule, and more time for the conversations that matter between a person living with
diabetes and their care team. Key benefits of automatic sync include: Continuous da

## [ Glooko Expands EHR Integration Through Xealth: Diabetes Data, Embedded in the EHR ][59]

July 15, 2026

For health systems that use Xealth to manage digital health applications, diabetes data integration
no longer needs to be a tradeoff between workflow simplicity and clinical depth. By deploying
Glooko’s diabetes management EHR integration capabilities through the Xealth platform, healthcare
providers can bring rich diabetes data directly into EHR workflows while preserving the architecture
and digital care strategy that care teams already trust. Many health systems rely on Xealth to
prescribe, deliver and monitor digital health tools directly from the EHR, making it a central part
of many digital care strategies. Xealth’s Digital Care SMART on FHIR capabilities allow clinicians
to launch digital solutions from existing charting workflows, surface partner dashboards within the
EHR, and return discrete patient data into the chart for easier review and follow-up care. By
integrating Glooko’s diabetes management platform through Xealth, clinicians can remain in their
familiar workflow while accessing Glooko diabetes reports, connected device data and discrete values
that support efficient documentation, informed decision-making and more streamlined diabetes visits.
Glooko Expanded EHR Capabilities Through the Xealth Platform Glooko EHR integrations through Xealth
can now support the complete suite of core capabilities health systems look for in a diabetes data
workflow: Glooko Patient Portal for Professionals: One-click access to the patient’s Glooko account
from within the EHR window, reducing the need to switch platforms or leave the EHR.* PDF Report
Integration: Attaches Glooko diabetes data to the patient’s EHR record. Flowsheet Statistics:
Delivers discrete data including pump settings into the flowsheet of the EHR for easy documentation
and analysis. Create Patient Account: Creates a patient account using data from the EHR. Single
Sign-On: Secure, centralized access for professional admin users. Functional Parity Through Xealth A
major advantage for health systems using Xealth is functional parity with Glooko’s broader EHR
integration package. For organizations that rely on Xealth as their digital health orchestration
layer, this means there is no need to compromise on integration depth. These health systems can
simply extend existing Xealth environments with Glooko, gaining both a full visual report for
clinical review and structured data that supports documentation, trending over time, and more robust
clinical analysis. Better Workflow, Better Clinical Context This integrated approach streamlines
day-to-day clinical workflows by reducing manual steps and making diabetes data easier to access at
the point of care. Instead of printing, scanning and uploading diabetes reports for every visit,
clinicians can receive Glooko PDF summaries automatically in the EHR, helping to eliminate a
time-consuming process and free up time during visits. Unlocking More Efficient, Data-Driven
Diabetes Care With Xealth and Glooko If your health system uses Xealth to manage digital health
applications, Glooko can extend that investment with EHR-integrated diabetes data workflows that
match the depth of a traditional integration approach. The result is a more efficient experience for
care teams, richer clinical context inside the EHR, and a stronger path to scalable, data-driven
diabetes care. To learn more, reach out to your dedicated Glooko Customer Success Manager or
[[email protected]][60].   *One-click access to Glooko patient accounts from within the EHR is
currently available for Epic only.

## [ The ROI of EHR-Integrated Diabetes Data ][63]

July 6, 2026

Download the Case Study Now The Challenge: Manual Bottlenecks & Disconnected Data Managing a high
volume of patients using hundreds of different diabetes devices created significant operational
challenges for Michigan Medicine, including: 25-Minute Rooming Process: Hunting for device cords and
logging into disparate platforms. Heavy Administrative Burden: Manually typing data from printed
device reports into patient charts. High Risk & Costs: Increased risk of human error with manual
data entry and massive paper waste (up to 100 pages per patient). The Solution: Seamless Epic®
Integration via Glooko Michigan Medicine deployed Glooko’s device-agnostic platform directly inside
their Epic® system, creating a unified, automated digital workflow with: One-Click Access: Direct
access from the patient chart via Single Sign-On (SSO). Automated Data Flow: Instant delivery of PDF
reports and flowsheet statistics upon device upload. Universal Compatibility: One secure platform
supporting over 200 diabetes device brands. Inside the Case Study: Proven Results: Measurable ROI of
improved efficiency, including $30K in direct cost savings annually and 91 full work days of
clinical time reclaimed. Blueprint: How they mapped low-effort, high-impact EHR enhancements.
Sustainability: Using “Centers of Truth” clinic hubs to onboard staff and mitigate turnover. Scale:
Moving from reactive data chasing to proactive, data-driven diabetes care. Get the Case Study Now
Discover how to eliminate administrative burden and reclaim clinical hours.

## [ Glooko Platform Adds Tandem Cloud Connectivity ][66]

June 29, 2026

The Glooko diabetes management platform is now cloud-connected with Tandem insulin pumps, giving
care teams automatic, continuous access to pump data without manual uploads, cables, or patient
intervention. Once a patient links their Tandem Source account, data will synchronize automatically
and continuously to the Glooko platform, ready for in-office visits and remote monitoring. This
integration reflects our ongoing commitment to ensure that wherever a patient’s data lives —
whichever device they wear, whichever platform stores it — that data flows seamlessly into the
platform their care team relies on. Expanding cloud connectivity is central to our mission of
bridging the gap between people living with diabetes and their healthcare providers. Why
Cloud-to-Cloud Integration Matters For people living with diabetes who use an insulin pump, data is
only useful if their care team can access it efficiently. Until now, that often meant asking
patients to remember to upload their device data before an appointment, or handling that step in the
clinic—an extra task that slows down the visit and, in some cases, means arriving without the data
at all. A direct cloud connection eliminates that friction. The Tandem mobile apps upload pump data
to the Tandem Source platform approximately once per hour. With this new integration, that
data—including basal and bolus deliveries, glucose trends, pump status, alerts and alarms—flows
automatically into the Glooko platform without cables or manual steps. What Automatic Sync Delivers

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

01

### Research

Sources are gathered from trusted clinical references and treatment guidelines.

02

### Writing

Complex topics are translated into clear, readable guidance for everyday decisions.

### Review

Medical review validates key facts, risk framing, and recommendation language.

04

### Update

Content is revised regularly to stay current with new standards and evidence.

01

### Research

Sources are gathered from trusted clinical references and treatment guidelines.

02

### Writing

Complex topics are translated into clear, readable guidance for everyday decisions.

03

### Review

Medical review validates key facts, risk framing, and recommendation language.

04

### Update

Content is revised regularly to stay current with new standards and evidence.

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.

continuous professional development (CPD) approach to teach transformation geometry. The research
objectives that guided this study's aim were to: Establish the extent of the use of GeoGebra and the
LS as a school-based CPD approach in mathematics teaching in high schools in the JTG district prior
to the main study. Investigate the level of TPACK developed when rural high school mathematics
teachers use GeoGebra to teach transformation geometry during a school-based LS CPD approach.
Investigate the experiences of rural high school mathematics teachers when teaching transformation
geometry using GeoGebra. The primary research question underlying this study is: What is the TPACK
development of mathematics teachers from rural high schools when using GeoGebra and the LS approach
as a form of school-based CPD to teach transformation geometry? The study employed a mixed methods
complementarity design, blending quantitative and qualitative approaches, guided primarily by an
interpretive paradigm, while acknowledging pragmatic considerations. A total of 135 mathematics
teachers from the 31 high schools in the Northern Cape Province's JTG district completed a baseline
survey. The baseline survey focused on the extent of technology use (in particular, GeoGebra) in
teaching mathematics and the nature of CPDs – a school-based LS CPD approach, in this case to which
teachers in the JTG district were exposed. Following the baseline survey, six teachers from two
specific schools (A and B) were selected purposively from the 31 high schools in the district for
further study. These teachers taught Senior and Further Education and Training (FET) Phase
mathematics at two rural high schools selected for research. Each of the two schools formed a LS
group of three teachers. These schools' selection criteria included inter alia that they were
located in low socio-economic areas, and that neither had a computer laboratory, although the
teachers had laptops and mobile projectors. The Theory of Didactical Situations (TDS) was used to
foreground this study. The data were collected from multiple sources, including a baseline survey,
focus group interviews (FGIs) conducted after the teacher training session on GeoGebra and the LS
with the six teachers and the three transformation geometry research lessons (RLs), and observation
guides. The three transformation geometry RLs focused on the concepts of reflection about the x- and
y-axis, reflection about the line y = x, and translation. The baseline survey findings showed
limited usage of GeoGebra and the LS in mathematics teaching within the JTG district's high schools.

resources and training, among others, were noted to be preventing the teachers from integrating the
software into their lessons. Additionally, factors including inter alia lack of support from school
administrators prevented teachers from implementing the LS in their schools. This necessitated
training teachers from the two schools on how to utilise GeoGebra to teach transformation geometry,
using a school-based LS CPD approach to develop their TPACK. The data gathered from the FGIs
conducted after the teacher training session on the use of GeoGebra and the LS, as well as the
three-transformation geometry RLs were analysed using the rubric of Niess et al. (2009). The aim was
to track individual teachers' TPACK development levels in each of the four descriptors of the five
TPACK levels, as shown by their self-reported scores and the researchers' interrater reliability
scores. The statements from individual teachers' reflections on their TPACK development levels from
training to RL3 are provided. These statements give an indication of where an individual teacher's
TPACK development level was in the five TPACK level descriptors. The two schools' findings revealed
that individual teachers transitioned from pre-recognising to the higher TPACK development levels
(exploring and advancing) from training to RL3. Additionally, a quantitative data analysis using a
repeated-measure analysis of variance (ANOVA) test was used to establish whether researchers'
ratings on teachers' TPACK knowledge in schools A and B differed significantly across the four
stages of professional development (training, RL1, RL2, and RL3) for each of the four TPACK

[Exploring barriers to and facilitators of immediate postpartum and newborn care by midwives in
Uganda][13]
(2026) Ssemwanga, Nassifu; Clow, Sheila; Walker, Sonja
Show more
Background: The postnatal period is a critical phase in the lives of mothers and newborn babies, and
almost half of the maternal and neonatal deaths occur in the first 24 hours after birth. However,
the barriers and facilitators to immediate postpartum and newborn care by midwives have received
little attention, most especially in developing countries, including Uganda. This study explored the
barriers to and facilitators of immediate postpartum and newborn care by midwives in Central Uganda.
Methods: This was a qualitative descriptive study conducted among purposively sampled midwives at
Gombe District Hospital, Central Uganda. Information was gathered through three focus group
discussions and four key informant interviews. Data were analysed using the inductive thematic
approach of Colaizzi. Results: All participants were females aged between 23 and 59 years. Three
themes emerged: “Optimising birth outcomes”, which reflects midwives understanding of the components
of immediate postpartum and newborn care; “Overwhelming experience”, which highlights barriers such
as a disabling work environment, demotivating conditions, and an uninformed practice; and
“Comprehensive support system”, which encompasses facilitators such as an enabling work environment,
effective leadership and management, and professional competence. An overarching theme,
“Contradictions in Perspectives”, highlights the inconsistencies between the viewpoints of frontline
midwives, who deal with daily realities, and midwifery managers, whose perspectives seem more
aspirational. Conclusion: These findings emphasise the need for specific interventions to address
barriers and strengthen facilitators, enhancing the overall quality of maternal care and birth
outcomes.

[Hewethu, ugoduka nini?][15]
(2026) Sogaula, Sihle; Mahashe, George; Malatjie, Portia
Show more
Hewethu, ugoduka nini? is a hybrid research and curatorial project that engages with the familial
archive of my late mother's studio, Lindro's House of Fashion, to develop ukugoduka as a nuanced
framework for working through personal and familial histories. Rooted in isiXhosa cultural
epistemologies, the project honors my mother's creative legacy while proposing ukugoduka as both a
physical return and a metaphorical journey of self-discovery and reconnection. Drawing on influences
from scholars such as Noni Jabavu, Lebogang Kganye, and Santu Mofokeng, this work brings together
personal and familial archives into an inquiry on cultural memory and identity. It bridges theory
and practice through photography, curatorial methods, and creative making, challenging traditional
binaries while foregrounding indigenous epistemologies. In part one, I develop a theoretical
framework for engaging personal archives, addressing the preservation of history through lived
experiences. In part two, I examine the curatorial gesture, considering how the book and the family
photo album function as records that negotiate tensions between institutionalized histories and
intimate memory. These forms of inscription open spaces where the boundaries of knowledge production
and legitimacy are both upheld and contested, contributing to a localized and personal genealogy for
contemporary scholarly and creative work

Juvenile onset recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (JoRRP) is a benign disease of the upper
aerodigestive tract that affects children 12 years and under (1). The incidence is 4 in 100 000
cases per annum in children (2). It is predominantly caused by the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) with
subtypes 6 and 11, accounting for over 90% of cases. The most common sites for these papillomata are
the larynx and trachea (3). Age at onset, specifically under the age of 5 years was found to be an
independent risk factor for a more aggressive clinical course (4,5). HPV subtype 11 is reportedly
also associated with a more aggressive form of the disease (6,7). There is no cure, and surgical
clearance of the obstructed airway is the current standard of treatment. JoRRP has a varied course,
but those with aggressive disease require multiple surgical interventions and, in some cases, a
tracheostomy. There is also an associated malignancy risk of 7% (8). The repeated visits to hospital
results in a high-cost burden to the patient, their family, and the health care system, with an
estimated cost recorded to be between $120-$150 million annually in the United States(2,9),

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of
#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115] 
[Milestones][116] 
[Pipeline & Clinical Trials ][117]

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

# All For Kansas City

For nearly 150 years, Saint Luke's has served the neighborhoods and communities of Kansas City. Now
as part of BJC Health, we continue to bring leading-edge care to every corner of our community.
Because every moment deserves exceptional care.

 

See why we're [All for Kansas City][53].

## Find Care

### Find a Provider

Need a provider? Search by name, specialty, or condition.

[Find a provider][59]

### Find Same-Day Care

Advanced, compassionate care from our experienced providers via videos visits or at our convenient
care clinics, urgent care clinics, emergency rooms.

[Find same-day care][60]

### Find a Location

We’re nearby to cover your health needs. Search our locations to find one close to home.


 

[See all locations][61]

## Personalized care at every stage to cover all your health needs.

Count on Saint Luke's to give you exceptional care from routine checkups to advanced procedures and
life-changing treatments for your entire family.

[Explore our services][62]

Saint Luke's includes 10 hospitals across the Kansas City region, plus dozens of physician

communities, and more.

# All For Kansas City

For nearly 150 years, Saint Luke's has served the neighborhoods and communities of Kansas City. Now
as part of BJC Health, we continue to bring leading-edge care to every corner of our community.
Because every moment deserves exceptional care.

 

See why we're [All for Kansas City][53].

### Find Same-Day Care

Advanced, compassionate care from our experienced providers via videos visits or at our convenient
care clinics, urgent care clinics, emergency rooms.

[Find same-day care][60]

### Find a Location

We’re nearby to cover your health needs. Search our locations to find one close to home.

Count on Saint Luke's to give you exceptional care from routine checkups to advanced procedures and
life-changing treatments for your entire family.

## Second Quarter 2026 Results

Second quarter 2026 results will be reviewed by management during a live audio webcast with the

Every day, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We apply our deep
understanding of the immune system to develop breakthrough innovations in medicines and vaccines so
you can focus on what matters most, chasing your dreams. If you’re chasing your dreams, remember...
you’re not alone. **We’re right beside you**

### **We're dedicated to advancing the field of anaphylaxis treatment and providing cutting-edge
### medical treatment options for severe allergic reactions.**

### Our portfolio includes innovative anaphylaxis medication and drugs specifically designed to meet
### the urgent needs of patients and healthcare providers. Through rigorous research and
### development, we have introduced solutions that aim to improve outcomes and save lives in
### critical situations.

### **For use by licensed health care professionals authorized to administer prescription
### medication. Available nationwide at your wholesaler or distributor.**

## Epinephrine Snap-V kit

$125.00

**Designed to treat anaphylaxis in patients weighing equal to or greater than 15 kg or 33
lbs.** Contains our proprietary Epinephrine Syringes™.  Epinephrine Snap-V kits contain (1) vial of
epinephrine 1 mg/ mL and supplies to administer **up to 3 doses**. U.S. Patent 1183336 and
additional patents pending.

[More info >][39]

[ [comp_ESnapV-min[1]] ][40]

## Epinephrine Snap-EMS kit

$120.00

**Specifically designed to meet the protocols of the Emergency Medical market.** For use in patients
equal to or greater than 15 kg or 33 lbs. Contains our proprietary Epinephrine Syringes™. 
Epinephrine Snap-EMS kits contain (1) vial of epinephrine 1 mg/ mL and supplies to administer **up
to 2 doses**. U.S. Patent 1183336 and additional patents pending.

[More info >][41]

[ [comp_ESnapEMS-min[1]] ][42]

## Epinephrine Snap kit

$120.00

**Can be utilized for adult, teen, and pediatric patients. **Epinephrine Snap kits contain (1) vial
of epinephrine 1 mg/ mL, and (3) 1 mL Non-Residue Gasket For Minimal Dead Space Syringes for more
precise dosing.

[More info >][43]

[ [comp_ESnap-min[1]] ][44]

## The Epinephrine Syringe

$268.00 (Box of 100)

**Our proprietary syringe** allows for easier dosing in anaphylactic emergencies. The Epinephrine
Syringes have visual markings for commonly utilized doses when treating anaphylaxis in patients
weighing 15 kg or 33 lbs*.

###### *See our resources page for anaphylaxis protocols

[More info >][45]

[ [The Epinephrine Syringe] ][46]

## Snap Med Pack

$15.00

**Designed for those creating their own medical kits**. The Pak comes empty and features a pocket
and elastic band to keep your customized selection of supplies in place.

[More info >][47]

[ [snapmedpak-min[1]] ][48]

Understanding the importance of immediate response, our products are engineered for ease of use and
effectiveness. From our Epinephrine Syringe™ injector to our comprehensive anaphylaxis kits, we
offer a range of options to ensure that medical professionals are prepared to act swiftly and
effectively. Our commitment to quality and patient safety drives our mission to develop the most
reliable and accessible epinephrine and anaphylaxis solutions on the market.

Snap Medical Industries stands at the forefront of anaphylaxis treatment innovation. By focusing on
the development of essential treatments for anaphylaxis, we aim to bridge the gap between medical
needs and available treatment options. Our goal is to empower the medical and dental community with
the tools and knowledge necessary for effective anaphylaxis management, making a significant impact
on healthcare outcomes worldwide.

## We serve the Medical, Dental, and EMS markets.

Snap Medical Industries spent two years researching and vetting ideas for our epinephrine products
based on clinical experience and the use of epinephrine in anaphylaxis. Our kits are a low-cost
alternative to epinephrine auto injectors.

We are a licensed manufacturer of epinephrine convenience kits with the Boards of Pharmacy
nationwide. Our products are registered with the FDA and we retain FDA experts to assure that our
kits are manufactured under the highest standards

### critical situations.

### medication. Available nationwide at your wholesaler or distributor.**

## Epinephrine Snap-V kit

$125.00

**Designed to treat anaphylaxis in patients weighing equal to or greater than 15 kg or 33
lbs.** Contains our proprietary Epinephrine Syringes™.  Epinephrine Snap-V kits contain (1) vial of
epinephrine 1 mg/ mL and supplies to administer **up to 3 doses**. U.S. Patent 1183336 and
additional patents pending.

[More info >][39]

## Epinephrine Snap-EMS kit

$120.00

**Specifically designed to meet the protocols of the Emergency Medical market.** For use in patients
equal to or greater than 15 kg or 33 lbs. Contains our proprietary Epinephrine Syringes™. 
Epinephrine Snap-EMS kits contain (1) vial of epinephrine 1 mg/ mL and supplies to administer **up
to 2 doses**. U.S. Patent 1183336 and additional patents pending.

[More info >][41]

[ [comp_ESnapEMS-min[1]] ][42]

## Epinephrine Snap kit

$120.00

**Can be utilized for adult, teen, and pediatric patients. **Epinephrine Snap kits contain (1) vial
of epinephrine 1 mg/ mL, and (3) 1 mL Non-Residue Gasket For Minimal Dead Space Syringes for more
precise dosing.

[More info >][43]

[ [comp_ESnap-min[1]] ][44]

## The Epinephrine Syringe

$268.00 (Box of 100)

**Our proprietary syringe** allows for easier dosing in anaphylactic emergencies. The Epinephrine
Syringes have visual markings for commonly utilized doses when treating anaphylaxis in patients
weighing 15 kg or 33 lbs*.

###### *See our resources page for anaphylaxis protocols

[More info >][45]

## Snap Med Pack

$15.00

**Designed for those creating their own medical kits**. The Pak comes empty and features a pocket
and elastic band to keep your customized selection of supplies in place.

[More info >][47]

[ [snapmedpak-min[1]] ][48]

Understanding the importance of immediate response, our products are engineered for ease of use and
effectiveness. From our Epinephrine Syringe™ injector to our comprehensive anaphylaxis kits, we
offer a range of options to ensure that medical professionals are prepared to act swiftly and
effectively. Our commitment to quality and patient safety drives our mission to develop the most
reliable and accessible epinephrine and anaphylaxis solutions on the market.

Snap Medical Industries stands at the forefront of anaphylaxis treatment innovation. By focusing on
the development of essential treatments for anaphylaxis, we aim to bridge the gap between medical
needs and available treatment options. Our goal is to empower the medical and dental community with
the tools and knowledge necessary for effective anaphylaxis management, making a significant impact
on healthcare outcomes worldwide.

## We serve the Medical, Dental, and EMS markets.

Snap Medical Industries spent two years researching and vetting ideas for our epinephrine products
based on clinical experience and the use of epinephrine in anaphylaxis. Our kits are a low-cost
alternative to epinephrine auto injectors.

We are a licensed manufacturer of epinephrine convenience kits with the Boards of Pharmacy
nationwide. Our products are registered with the FDA and we retain FDA experts to assure that our
kits are manufactured under the highest standards available.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

Anaphylaxis can be life threatening, can happen within minutes, and can be caused by stinging and
biting insects, allergy injections, foods, medicines, exercise, or unknown causes. **Always carry
your Epinephrine Injection (Auto-Injector) with you because you may not know when anaphylaxis may
happen.**

**When you have an allergic emergency (anaphylaxis)**
* **Use Epinephrine Injection (Auto-Injector) right away.**
* **Get emergency medical help right away.** You may need further medical attention. You may need to
  use a second Epinephrine Injection (Auto-Injector) if symptoms continue or recur. Only a

## Our Doctors

Internal Medicine

### [James Kingsley, M.D.][31]

Dr. James Kingsley is a caring physician who listens to patients’ symptoms and stories with empathy
and kindness. He founded The Kingsley Clinic to provide high-quality, evidence-based healthcare to
all patients, no matter their background or circumstance.

## What we Treat

If you’re looking for an urgent care nearby, but prefer to avoid exposure to COVID-19 or simply
prefer the convenience of seeing an online doctor, then we can help you at the Kingsley Clinic.  If
you would like to know whether what you need to be seen for can be managed online ask our front desk
for help.  If it is something you are planning to have evaluated at an urgent care center or it’s
something that your primary care physician typically helps you with, then a Kingsley Clinic doctor
can help you.

Our board certified doctors see and treat patients with both new symptoms and chronic medical
conditions.  We can also help with any medication refills or referrals you might need. Our
physicians see pediatric, adult and geriatric patients.

## Patient Reviews

providers. I have had nothing but great experiences with this group. No issues with scheduling a
telehealth appointment, the support team ALWAYS responds to emails and phone calls within the hour.
I’ve been seen by multiple medical providers within this group and they all have been very
professional, caring, thorough, genuine and a true pleasure to interact with. My prescriptions are
always sent to the correct pharmacy within the hour, no issues ever. No issues with my insurance
covering the costs, either. I’ve never had to wait more than 10 minutes for my video visits to
start. They have even called me before my appointment time, to let me know I could be seen early. I
am completely satisfied and would definitely recommend this group to anyone who is in network with
them.

## Our Doctors

[ ][30]

Internal Medicine

### [James Kingsley, M.D.][31]

Dr. James Kingsley is a caring physician who listens to patients’ symptoms and stories with empathy
and kindness. He founded The Kingsley Clinic to provide high-quality, evidence-based healthcare to
all patients, no matter their background or circumstance.

## What we Treat

If you’re looking for an urgent care nearby, but prefer to avoid exposure to COVID-19 or simply
prefer the convenience of seeing an online doctor, then we can help you at the Kingsley Clinic.  If
you would like to know whether what you need to be seen for can be managed online ask our front desk
for help.  If it is something you are planning to have evaluated at an urgent care center or it’s
something that your primary care physician typically helps you with, then a Kingsley Clinic doctor
can help you.

Our board certified doctors see and treat patients with both new symptoms and chronic medical
conditions.  We can also help with any medication refills or referrals you might need. Our
physicians see pediatric, adult and geriatric patients.

always sent to the correct pharmacy within the hour, no issues ever. No issues with my insurance
covering the costs, either. I’ve never had to wait more than 10 minutes for my video visits to
start. They have even called me before my appointment time, to let me know I could be seen early. I
am completely satisfied and would definitely recommend this group to anyone who is in network with

## Discover More

Our Relentless Pursuit of Healing

[A black woman, smiling at a desk that has flowers and a pride flag displayed on it.]
Awards and Recognitions

### [ Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][154]

UMass Memorial earns recognition as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader, demonstrating its
commitment to inclusive, high-quality care for all.

[ Learn More about Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][155]
[A little girl high-fives the doctor in Urgent Care having had her ankle bandaged and a bad scrape
treated.]
Services-Treatments

### [ Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][156]

Summer happens — bites, burns, scrapes and all. Get expert care fast at a convenient UMass Memorial
Health urgent care location. On-site X-ray and labs are available.

 

[ Learn More about Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][157]
[A woman waves hello to a group of people in an online meeting.]
7.20.26 | Support Groups

### [ Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][158]

Join us on Monday, July 20, with special guest Carisa Lozoraitis, Cancer Quality Program Manager at
the Medical Center. We will have an open discussion, share information, and exchange experiences.

[ Learn More about Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][159]
[A CRNA in an operating room, smiling and looking at the camera.]
Careers

### [ We’re Hiring CRNAs ][160]

Join our team of outstanding CRNAs. We’ll offer you a strong and supportive culture, flexible
schedules, career growth opportunities and great benefits.

[ Learn More about We’re Hiring CRNAs ][161]

## Our System of Care

UMass Memorial Health is the health and wellness partner of the people of Central Massachusetts and
beyond. Our health system is made up of five hospitals, including a children’s medical center,
behavioral health services and a dedicated provider group.

Awards and Recognitions

### [ Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][154]

commitment to inclusive, high-quality care for all.

### [ Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][156]

Summer happens — bites, burns, scrapes and all. Get expert care fast at a convenient UMass Memorial
Health urgent care location. On-site X-ray and labs are available.

 

[ Learn More about Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][157]

### [ Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][158]

the Medical Center. We will have an open discussion, share information, and exchange experiences.

[ Learn More about Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][159]

Careers

### [ We’re Hiring CRNAs ][160]

Join our team of outstanding CRNAs. We’ll offer you a strong and supportive culture, flexible
schedules, career growth opportunities and great benefits.

[ Learn More about We’re Hiring CRNAs ][161]

UMass Memorial Health is the health and wellness partner of the people of Central Massachusetts and
beyond. Our health system is made up of five hospitals, including a children’s medical center,
behavioral health services and a dedicated provider group.

This delivery method of bronchodilator therapy is suitable for use when oral administration is not
feasible.

**Amanda Ye, RPh, PharmD**

Patient Teaching Aid
[Hantavirus][176]
It is important to start supportive care as soon as possible and to watch closely for heart, lung,
or kidney complications.



TrendWatch
[Utilization and Effectiveness of Biologics for Severe Asthma][177]
Despite treatment advances, this chronic respiratory disease continues to cause a substantial number
of emergency-department visits and hospitalizations.

**Olga Hilas, PharmD, MPH, BCPS, BCGP, FASCP**

Consult Your Pharmacist
[Optimizing Patient Counseling in Pharmacy Practice][178]
Federal and state requirements for this key job responsibility have existed for decades;
nevertheless, variability persists in both quality and consistency.

****Emily M. Ambizas, PharmD, MPH, BCGP**

Pharmacy Focus
[Zika Virus Reemergence][179]
Although widespread outbreaks have subsided, this mosquito-borne disease continues to circulate at
low levels in parts of the world, raising concerns as population immunity wanes.


**Manouchehr Saljoughian, PharmD, PhD**

[PBM Reform Reshaping Pharmacy Reimbursement][180]

practices and their effect on pharmacies’ financial viability and patient access.


**Michael A. Dowell, RPh, JD

## Mission Statement

[**WestJEM focuses on how the systems and delivery of emergency care affects health, health
disparities, and health outcomes in communities and populations worldwide, including the impact of
social conditions on the composition of patients seeking care in emergency departments. **][192]

## Our Philosophy

Emergency Medicine is a specialty which closely reflects societal challenges and consequences of
public policy decisions. The emergency department specifically deals with social injustice, health
and economic disparities, violence, substance abuse, and disaster preparedness and response. This
journal focuses on how emergency care affects the health of the community and population, and
conversely, how these societal challenges affect the composition of the patient population who seek
care in the emergency department. The development of better systems to provide emergency care,
including technology solutions, is critical to enhancing population health.

## Our Philosophy

Emergency Medicine is a specialty which closely reflects societal challenges and consequences of
public policy decisions. The emergency department specifically deals with social injustice, health
and economic disparities, violence, substance abuse, and disaster preparedness and response. This
journal focuses on how emergency care affects the health of the community and population, and
conversely, how these societal challenges affect the composition of the patient population who seek
care in the emergency department. The development of better systems to provide emergency care,
including technology solutions, is critical to enhancing population health.

## [Peanut-free Easter treats for kids][74]

By [jaelithe][75] [March 20, 2018][76] July 19, 2018 [Holidays][77]
[[Chocolate Easter Bunny | When Peanuts Attack]][78]

It can be a bit of a challenge to find peanut-free treats for Easter baskets. Most of those cute
chocolate bunnies and eggs on grocery and drug store shelves have a not-so-cute MAY CONTAIN PEANUTS
OR TREE NUTS warning on the back. And even candies that don’t have allergen advisory labeling may
pose some risk, since companies are not required by the FDA to label for the risk of accidental
allergen cross contact. Luckily, this year, the Easter Bunny has helpfully provided When Peanuts
Attack with a list of allergy-friendly companies that make safe Easter treats for children with
peanut… [Read more][79]

[No comments][80]

By [jaelithe][82] [October 16, 2017][83] July 19, 2018 [Holidays][84]

Participating in the Teal Pumpkin Project this year, but stumped on finding food allergy friendly,
food-free treats for Halloween? Here are some ideas for treats without tricks: Spinning tops.
Plastic spiders.   Bouncy balls. Glow sticks. Water bottles. (Seriously — these were my most popular
item last year — do you know how far kids walk trick-or-treating?) Want to put out a separate bowl
of allergy-friendly candy, too, in addition to your food-free Teal Pumpkin treats? Try these
nut-free and top 8 free Halloween candies. Questions on how to participate? Find more information
about the Teal Pumpkin Project on When… [Read more][85]

## [There is no A for effort in food allergies][93]

By [jaelithe][94] [May 6, 2017][95] July 7, 2018 [Food Safety][96]

It does not matter how much love you put into it. It does not matter how long you spent preparing
it. It does not matter how pretty it looks, or how much money you spent on it. It does not matter
whether it’s delicious. It doesn’t matter how hard you feel you tried to make the food safe, or how
much you wanted the food to be safe. If a food is not safe for a person with a food allergy to eat,
it’s just not. And you should not expect a person with a food allergy to eat it.… [Read more][97]

## [How to report an allergic reaction to the FDA or USDA][103]

By [jaelithe][104] [April 6, 2017][105] July 16, 2018 [Food Safety][106]

Did you know that undeclared food allergens are a leading cause of food recalls in the United
States? According to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), from September 2009 to September
2012, about one-third of reports to the agency for serious food safety violations involved top 8
food allergens that were not properly listed on food labels. The foods most often reported to the
FDA for containing undeclared allergens include bakery products (like bread, cakes, and cupcakes),
snack foods, candy, and dairy products. The allergens most often involved in FDA food safety recalls
have been milk, wheat and soy. The… [Read more][107]

## [Help kids with food allergies have a safe and happy Halloween][113]

By [jaelithe][114] [October 31, 2015][115] October 31, 2015 [Food Safety][116], [Holidays][117]

NOTICE for anyone who would like to help keep the 1 out of 13 American kids who have food allergies
safe and out of the hospital tonight: Consider the following options for safer Halloween treats:
Nut-free candies: Tootsie Rolls, Tootsie Pops, Charms lollipops, Charms Blow Pops, Dubble Bubble
